description: Save an exclusion in the account targeting so later searches skip matching people: a job title keyword, an industry, or a company size limit. With candidateId (a result just rejected), matching people still waiting in that same search are removed too. The user can see and remove exclusions with get_icp and remove_exclusion.

candidateId.description: A result from the search whose queue should also be cleared of matching people

direction.description: For size: exclude companies over or under that many employees

kind.description: title = a word in the job title, industry = a company industry, size = a company headcount limit

value.description: The title keyword (at least 5 characters: it hides every title containing it), the industry name, or the number of employees

name: add_exclusion
title: Exclude a kind of lead
